Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring video game retailers to inform consumers about video game rating systems.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to video games; and adding a new section to chapter19.188 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.188 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The definitions in this subsection apply throughout thissection. (a) "Video game" means an object or device that stores recordeddata or instructions, receives data or instructions generated by aperson who uses it, and, by processing the data or instructions,creates an interactive game capable of being played, viewed, orexperienced on or through a computer, gaming system, console, or othertechnology. (b) "Video game retailer" means a person who sells or rents videogames to the public. (c) "Point of sale" means the location in the retail establishmentat which a transaction occurs resulting in the sale or rental of avideo game. p. 1 SHB 1366 (2) Every video game retailer shall post signs providinginformation to consumers about the existence of a nationally recognizedvideo game rating system, or notifying consumers that a rating systemis available, to aid in the selection of a game if such a rating systemis in existence. (3) The signs shall be posted within the retail establishment inprominent areas near the video game displays and points of sale. Thesigns and lettering shall be clearly visible to consumers at theselocations. (4) A video game retailer shall make available to consumers, uponrequest, information that explains the video game rating system.
